preamble.summary: Psalm 148 (MT = LXX Ps 148, numbering-alignment restored) is the COSMIC-HALLELUJAH — summoning every-level-of-creation to praise YHWH: angels and hosts (vv. 1–2), sun/moon/stars (vv. 3), heavens-above-the-heavens and waters-above-the-heavens (v. 4), sea-monsters and deeps (v. 7), weather (v. 8), mountains and trees (v. 9), beasts and birds (v. 10), humans (vv. 11–12), and finally 'his people Israel' (v. 14). The Patristic-tradition's LAUDATE canticle (sung at Lauds daily in the Western Church) draws directly from this psalm.
preamble.notable_variants: 148:1–14 COSMIC HALLEL — every creature summoned to praise; the descent-from-heavens-through-atmosphere-through-earth-to-humanity structure; the LAUDATE canticle of Christian Lauds.
preamble.structural_notes: MT Ps 148 = LXX Ps 148 (numbering re-aligned). 14 verses. COSMIC HALLEL.

variant_notes: 'Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD from the heavens; praise him in the heights!' tracks MT. LAUDATE opening. Latin: 'Laudate Dominum de caelis.' The traditional-Christian Lauds opening-antiphon.
'Praise him, all his angels; praise him, all his hosts!' tracks MT. ANGELS-AND-HOSTS summoned. Revelation 5:11–12 ('numbering myriads of myriads and thousands of thousands') extends.

'Praise him, sun and moon, praise him, all you shining stars!' tracks MT. SUN-MOON-STARS summoned. In contrast with Greco-Roman-astrolatry (worship-of-the-heavenly-bodies), the psalm makes the heavenly-bodies subordinate-worshipers.
'Praise him, you highest heavens, and you waters above the heavens!' tracks MT. WATERS-ABOVE-HEAVENS — Genesis 1:7 firmament cosmology.

'Let them praise the name of the LORD! For he commanded and they were created' tracks MT. HE-COMMANDED-AND-THEY-WERE-CREATED — creation-by-divine-word. Hebrews 11:3 ('the universe was created by the word of God') directly echoes.
'And he established them forever and ever; he gave a decree, and it shall not pass away' tracks MT.
'Praise the LORD from the earth, you great sea creatures and all deeps' tracks MT. SEA-CREATURES summoned. Even the once-chaotic Leviathan-tanninim now-praise.

'Fire and hail, snow and mist, stormy wind fulfilling his word!' tracks MT. WEATHER-ELEMENTS as divine-command-executors. Matthew 8:27 ('what sort of man is this, that even winds and sea obey him?') Christologically applies.
'Mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars!' tracks MT.
'Beasts and all livestock, creeping things and flying birds!' tracks MT. FOUR ANIMAL-CATEGORIES of Genesis 1.
'Kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all rulers of the earth!' tracks MT. HUMAN-AUTHORITIES summoned — subordinate-to-divine-kingship.
'Young men and maidens together, old men and children!' tracks MT. FOUR LIFE-STAGES (young men, maidens, old men, children) — all-ages-praise.

'Let them praise the name of the LORD, for his name alone is exalted; his majesty is above earth and heaven' tracks MT. NAME-ALONE-EXALTED. Philippians 2:9 ('God highly exalted him and bestowed on him the name that is ABOVE EVERY NAME') Christologically extends.

'He has raised up a horn for his people, praise for all his saints, for the people of Israel who are near to him. Praise the LORD!' tracks MT. HORN-FOR-HIS-PEOPLE — the Messianic-horn language from Ps 132:17 picked up at Luke 1:69's Benedictus ('horn of salvation in the house of his servant David'). 'PEOPLE NEAR TO HIM' (am qerovo / laos eggizonta autō) — covenant-intimacy. Ephesians 2:13 ('you who once were far off have been BROUGHT NEAR') extends Christologically.
